# Contributing Guide

Thank you for helping improve **Malaysia Living Cost**!

## How to Contribute
1. Fork the repository  
2. Create a branch  
3. Add/update content  
4. Submit a Pull Request  

## Content Rules
- Only include **realistic and verified** prices  
- Add the **location** (KL, Selangor, Penang)  
- Attach receipts/images if possible  
- Keep formatting neat and simple  

## Folder Rules
- Data → category-specific details  
- Comparisons → country/city/family comparisons  
- Templates → reusable budget templates  
- Images → screenshots & charts  

## Markdown Style
- Use headings, bullet points  
- Add tables when comparing prices
